title: アーカイブ・リペアーズ：失われた言葉の修復師たち
author: 野分 風太

en.title: Archive Repairers: Restorers of Lost Words
en.premise: As a novice entering the world of ancient document restoration, I begin to learn the pride and mastery of the craftsmen around me. One day, in the 'Underground Library' hidden in the deepest reaches of the center, I discover a 'lost letter' left abandoned, its destination unknown. As I search for the letter's owner, I uncover the unexpected pasts of my colleagues and discover the true meaning of leaving words behind. A tale of how the meticulous work of repairing small fragments of paper can mend and reconnect the threads of a human life.

zh.title: 档案修复师：遗失之语的修复师们
zh.premise: 踏入古籍修复之道的职场新人我，在学习匠人们的执着与技艺的过程中，展开了一段故事。某日，在中心最深处的“地下图书馆”中，我发现了一封没有收件人、被长期遗忘的“遗失之信”。在追寻信件主人的过程中，我逐渐触及到同事们不为人知的过去，以及“留下文字”这一行为的深远意义。这是一个关于修复小小纸片这种枯燥工作，却在瞬间将某人的生命重新连接起来的故事。
